title: Crawling Baby Kem at 6 Months, 1958 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white 1958 snapshot of a six-month-old baby named Kem crawling across a white quilted blanket inside a home. The back is inscribed with the date September 9, 1958, capturing a classic infant milestone during the post-World War II American baby boom.
